sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Earth Release, Fire Release
sourceHeader.components: HS, CM, W (any Shuriken or Chakram)

system.description:
You use Lava release Chakra to augment a Shuriken or Chakram that you have turning it into a bright red glowing piece of metal that keeps the shape of the Ninja tool used. You then throw them with extreme force. Make a ranged Ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack and if a Shuriken is used for this jutsu, you reduce your ammunition die by 1 step. On a hit, you deal [Weapon Damage] + 3d10 Fire damage.

All creatures within 10 feet of the original target must make a Dexterity saving throw, being Molten until the end of your next turn on a failure.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d10
